notes: Parliament added exactly 60,000,000 FCFA to this programme during passage** — 30,079,589,283 in the bill, 30,139,589,283 enacted; programme 117 was unchanged at 1,065,948,780, so the whole of the ministry's +60,000,000 fell here. That is the only change to Code 45 between bill and law. · The digital vote grew 30.5% on FY2025's appropriation** (23,093,583,163 → 30,139,589,283) and the ministry total 29.6% (24,078,665,787 → 31,205,538,063), against a budget général that grew from 2,059,000,000,000 to 2,139,267,000,000 (3.9%). · `Décret n° 2026-179 du 8 mai 2026` did not touch this vote.** The decree cancels 433,877,815,955 FCFA and opens 438,877,815,955 across the post-reshuffle ministry structure, and **Code 45 appears in neither its cancellation table nor its opening table**, so no `revised` stage is held for FY2026. A *loi de finances rectificative* was adopted by both chambers on 23 July 2026 and is not yet gazetted; when it is, it will carry the revised figure. · Programme 117 *Pilotage de la politique du ministère* is not recorded** — 1,065,948,780 in both bill and law; its stated purpose is ministry steering, not a digital activity. · Cross-footed twice.** 1,065,948,780 + 30,139,589,283 = 31,205,538,063, the printed Code 45 total in Article trente-quatrième; and Article trente-neuvième's Titre 2 483,047,997 + Titre 3 688,160,066 + Titre 4 1,308,330,000 = sous-total 2,479,538,063, plus Titre 5 28,726,000,000 = the same 31,205,538,063. · Read by geometry, not by text stream.** Under `pdftotext -layout` the FY2026 law prints Code 45 at 20,272,823,267 — which is in fact Code 44 programme 061 *Transports terrestre et aérien* — and programme 117 at 2,765,963,762, which is Code 44 programme 062. No Congolese figure may be recorded before geometry binding. · `amount_usd` left blank.** `lookups/fx-imf-annual.csv` carries XAF only as a ball-park euro-peg derivation, not a named fiscal-year average from IMF IFS or the BEAC, and the driver forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure.
